text:
nina: quick thought1 routing keeps thrashing between reserved A100s and cheap L4s. thinking of a tiny per-request budget hint to bias admission instead of hard-coding device prefs.

sam: can you sketch the hint? header or field in SDK?

nina: header: X-Redwood-Budget: low|med|high. default derived from route. SDK can override.

kevin: +1. admission should consume hint, not scorer. keep scorer returning est_latency & est_cost. admission applies tenant SLOs + budget to pick route.

anya: concerned about starvation. low budget requests could swamp cold lanes. propose two guardrails: per-shard max_low_inflight and short token-bucket that grants limited bypass to warm lanes. tokens refill on fast completions.

sam: rollout plan: 1) simulation/replay on last 48h, 2) shadow for 0.1% traffic, 3) gradual increase with metrics gating.

kevin: telemetry needed: per-device inflight, queue_time_p99, completions by budget tag, reserved_pool_hit_rate by tenant.

ops-bot: infra: created shadow cluster routing-budget-shadow-1 for nina/budget-proto :white_check_mark:

anya: also add fairness metric: reserv_pct_by_tier so we can detect low-tier tenants being evicted from reserved pools.

nina: i'll draft RFC: header proto, scorer minimal change (est_latency, est_cost), admission rules, guardrails, telemetry + replay checklist. assigning to myself. ping for review when ready.

sam: lgtm, include a compatibility note for older adapters that only return scalar score.

kevin: small nit: decision rationale header would help debugging (chosen_route + top2 alternatives). please include.

nina: will do, thanks all.
